# Coverage matrix

Each skill in [claude-red](https://github.com/SnailSploit/claude-red) that umbra-blue answers, paired to its defensive counterpart. Each offensive technique implies the detection, hunt, or hardening that counters it, in the spirit of MITRE D3FEND.

<!-- Generated by tools/build_manifest.py from tools/pairs.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

81 pairings cover all 79 claude-red skills, answered by 78 umbra-blue skills: 10 Tier 1 and 68 Tier 2. A few red skills map to more than one blue skill, and a few blue skills answer more than one red skill.

| Tier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Sourced. Built from a published UMBRASEC writeup or tool and cites primary sources. Ships a runnable detection or hunt; any rule is reused byte for byte from the UMBRASEC sigma-pack. |
| 2 | Methodology. Gives the defender's method, log sources, hunt, and hardening, and points to public rule sources. Carries a banner saying no bespoke UMBRASEC rule ships yet. Never fabricates a rule or a citation. |

A Tier 2 skill is promoted to Tier 1 when its UMBRASEC writeup and tuned rule land.

The Mapper column opens each skill's page in the [Blue Team Mapper](https://umbrasec-labs.github.io/BlueTeamMapper/). It shows the skill's ATT&CK techniques and any UMBRASEC rules for them. Where those techniques are in the mapper matrix, it also shows the matrix rows, the response flow chains they lead to, and your own coverage rating.
